strings.دروس تشطيب البيت في الكويت 1: جهّز ملف ا: Home finishing lessons in Kuwait 1: record your requirements before requesting prices
strings.مقبل على بناء بيت أو تشطيب شقة في الكويت: Building a home or finishing an apartment in Kuwait and unsure where to start? Prepare a room-by-room requirements record before collecting prices and choosing colours. Knowing what to retain and what needs installation makes discussions with the designer and contractor clearer and reduces conflicting decisions. This Almusaileem Paints & Decor lesson establishes a finishing brief that can be understood and reviewed.
strings.تصميم توضيحي لمخطط بيت وملف مشروع وعينات: Explanatory design of a house planner, project file, materials samples and measuring tape on a table
strings.تصميم توضيحي مولّد بالذكاء الاصطناعي، ول: AI-generated illustration, not a photograph of a completed Almusaileem project.
strings.شنو راح تنجز في هذا الدرس؟: What will you accomplish in this lesson?
strings.راح تطلع بورقة مشروع مختصرة تجمع حالة ال: Look for a brief project paper that combines the status of the place, use of rooms, family priorities, and deferred decisions. The planner needs to provide up-to-date images of the site. The measurements you record yourself are useful in the initial discussion, but they do not replace lifting and field verification before supply and implementation. If the project is a new construction, coordination with the designer and specialists begins from an early stage, before the arrival of the decoration team.
strings.اكتب هل عندك بيت جديد، شقة جاهزة تحتاج ت: Write down whether you have a new house, a ready-made apartment that needs changes, or an existing house with problems that require examination. Do not group all cases under the word “finishing”. In renovation, without what will remain such as floor and doors, what you want to change, and any traces of moisture or damage that need to be evaluated. In the new construction, explain the current stage, approved plans and the supervising body.
strings.افصل بين رغبة شكلية وملاحظة فنية. تغيير: Separate a formal desire from an artistic note. Changing the color of the lounge is a decorative decision, but an unexplained leak or crack will need the right specialist to determine the cause. Do not rely on covering the problem with a new garment before evaluating it. This chapter helps you ask for the right work, and prevents an incomprehensible item from entering the decor display.
strings.اكتب استخدام كل غرفة قبل شكلها: Write the use of each room before its shape
strings.ابدأ بالصالة والديوانية وغرف النوم والمم: Start with the lounge, courtyards, bedrooms and hallways. Write down how many uses are in each space, what furniture will remain, where to watch and store, and what’s bothering you in the current situation. If you want a screen wall, record the hardware and cabinet required before choosing a cladding shape. And if you think of a hidden door, mention it early for the specialist to review its relationship with the hole and the adjacent finish.
strings.في مثال تخطيطي، قد تكون أولوية أسرة الاح: In a schematic example, the priority of a family may be to keep the floor and coordinate the paint with it, while a second family needs more storage space. The same house space does not mean the same list of works. So keep two or three images that express your taste, and add a specific note for each image: color, distribution of materials, or detail you like. The image is a reference for discussion and not a complete implementation specification.
strings.قسّم رغباتك إلى أساسي، مرغوب، وقابل للتأ: Divide your wishes into a basic, desirable, and postponable. Record the available budget for internal discussion, without assuming that a fixed amount fits all projects. Ask about the impact of postponing any item on other work; some details need to be processed early even if their final installation is delayed. Select someone from the family to collect notes and adopt the latest version so that different instructions do not arrive to the implementer.
